--- /workspace/todo-app/app.js
+++ /workspace/todo-app/app.js
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+const { createApp } = Vue
@@ -1,0 +3,73 @@
+const STORAGE_KEY = 'vue-todo-list'
+
+createApp({
+    data() {
+        return {
+            todos: [],
+            newTodoText: '',
+            newTodoDueDate: '',
+            editingTodo: null,
+            editingText: '',
+            editingDueDate: ''
+        }
+    },
+    methods: {
+        loadTodos() {
+            const savedTodos = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)
+            if (savedTodos) {
+                this.todos = JSON.parse(savedTodos)
+            }
+        },
+        saveTodos() {
+            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.todos))
+        },
+        addTodo() {
+            if (!this.newTodoText.trim()) return
+
+            const todo = {
+                id: Date.now(),
+                text: this.newTodoText.trim(),
+                completed: false,
+                dueDate: this.newTodoDueDate || null
+            }
+
+            this.todos.push(todo)
+            this.newTodoText = ''
+            this.newTodoDueDate = ''
+            this.saveTodos()
+        },
+        toggleTodo(todo) {
+            todo.completed = !todo.completed
+            this.saveTodos()
+        },
+        removeTodo(todo) {
+            const index = this.todos.indexOf(todo)
+            if (index > -1) {
+                this.todos.splice(index, 1)
+                this.saveTodos()
+            }
+        },
+        startEdit(todo) {
+            this.editingTodo = todo.id
+            this.editingText = todo.text
+            this.editingDueDate = todo.dueDate || ''
+        },
+        saveTodoEdit(todo) {
+            if (!this.editingText.trim()) return
+
+            todo.text = this.editingText.trim()
+            todo.dueDate = this.editingDueDate || null
+            this.editingTodo = null
+            this.saveTodos()
+        },
+        cancelEdit() {
+            this.editingTodo = null
+        },
+        formatDate(dateString) {
+            return new Date(dateString).toLocaleDateString()
+        }
+    },
+    mounted() {
+        this.loadTodos()
+    }
+}).mount('#app')
